description: Allocatable reviewer membership. Health is not membership: a provider whose local install is healthy is still unusable unless it is carried in the allocating registry (popcre/shared-db scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs REVIEWERS). This file is the ai-devops mirror of that membership so one command can answer 'can I use this reviewer right now'. It is a guard: never flip a provider to registered to make an allocation succeed.

claude.reason: Approval-gate reviewer; never reviews a Claude-orchestrated issue.

codex.reason: Approval-gate wrapper only (ai-codex-review one-shot modes, like the Claude gate); NOT a rotation or overflow reviewer. popcre/shared-db RETIRED_REVIEWERS carries codex-gpt-5.6-sol since 2026-09-06 (shared-db issue #2485), so the allocator never assigns it; owner confirmed on 2026-09-22 that the rotation pool is Muse, Grok, Qwen, Gemini.

deepseek.reason: Rotation reviewer (deepseek-flash = DeepSeek V4.1 Flash). Re-entered the pool by owner instruction on 2026-09-23 ("put DeepSeek back on the reviewer list") after PR #730 gave it read-only repository tools, a recorded live preflight qualification, and a live formal review of a merged commit that returned a well-formed VERDICT line with the head SHA; see the 2026-09-23 deepseek-requalification record under reviewer-reliability verification. Mirrors the shared-db allocator row deepseek-v4.1-flash (shared-db #3469); the old deepseek-chat name stays retired there.

gemini.reason: Rotation reviewer (gemini-3.8-flash-high). Re-entered the allocating registry on 2026-09-06 after a recorded live safety qualification and a live review of merged commit 99fbefcb that returned a well-formed VERDICT APPROVE line carrying the head SHA above 3,137 characters of real analysis. The earlier bare PASS with an empty report is now caught for every provider by the lifecycle report floor, not trusted.

glm.reason: Removed from reviewer rotation by owner instruction on 2026-09-22 ("we took GLM out of rotation and we have 4 reviewers: Muse, Grok, Qwen, Gemini"); matches popcre/shared-db RETIRED_REVIEWERS, which carries glm-5.3 since 2026-09-18. No review routes to GLM. Re-entry requires owner instruction and a reviewed registry change in both repositories.

kimi.reason: Temporarily removed from reviewer rotation by owner instruction on 2026-09-10: the Kimi account is out of credit. Historical evidence and wrapper safety checks remain retained; re-entry requires a reviewed registry change backed by a live well-formed verdict.

qwen.reason: Live-qualified 2026-09-07: live probe OK and a real bounded review returned a valid verdict on qwen3.8-max. Runs on the Model Studio pay-per-token lane; the Coding Plan subscription key is dead.

stepfun.reason: StepFun Step 5 (step/step-5-preview through the StepCode CLI, bin/ai-stepfun). Added by owner instruction on 2026-09-25 as a reviewer on Ubuntu/Linux only: StepCode is not yet available on Windows, so ai-review-preflight reports it unsupported-platform there. In the shared-db allocator rotation since 2026-09-25 (owner instruction "put stepfun into the reviewer rotation"; shared-db row stepfun-step-5-preview, popcre/shared-db#3554); a Windows machine never draws it because its preflight is unusable there; read-only tools read/grep/find/ls in a disposable review copy.
